result.summary: Found several issues: a critical data display bug showing NaN for delivery cost, truncated restaurant names, and a minor layout overflow on category chips.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid delivery fee, indicating a data formatting or null-handling bug.
issues.suggestion: Handle null/undefined delivery prices gracefully (e.g. show 'Free', '€0', or hide the fee) and ensure numeric values are properly parsed before display.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you carousel card.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or use ellipsis with full name on detail view so names are fully readable.

issues.description: Category filter chips row shows a partial empty chip on the far right, suggesting awkward overflow beyond the intentional partial last item.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal padding and chip spacing so only intentional content peeks at the edge without empty ghost chips.
